ENTERPRISE CLOUD SECURITY MANUAL v1.0

Section 1: Encryption
Risk: Unencrypted data at rest may lead to data exposure.
Control CTRL-ENC-01: All object storage must enable AES-256 encryption at rest.
Control CTRL-ENC-02: TLS 1.2+ required for data in transit.
Requirement: Encryption keys must be rotated every 90 days.

Section 2: Access Control
Risk: Overly permissive IAM roles enable privilege escalation.
Control CTRL-IAM-01: Enforce MFA for all privileged accounts.
Control CTRL-IAM-02: Apply least-privilege RBAC on production buckets.
Requirement: Break-glass accounts must be monitored.

Section 3: Monitoring
Risk: Lack of audit logging delays incident response.
Control CTRL-MON-01: Enable access logging on all storage accounts.
Requirement: Retain logs for 365 days.

versions.text:
ENTERPRISE CLOUD SECURITY MANUAL v2.0

Section 1: Encryption
Risk: Unencrypted data at rest may lead to data exposure.
Control CTRL-ENC-01: All object storage must enable AES-256 encryption at rest.
Control CTRL-ENC-02: TLS 1.3 required for data in transit.
Control CTRL-ENC-03: Customer-managed keys required for regulated workloads.
Requirement: Encryption keys must be rotated every 60 days.

Section 2: Access Control
Risk: Overly permissive IAM roles enable privilege escalation.
Control CTRL-IAM-01: Enforce MFA for all privileged accounts.
Control CTRL-IAM-02: Apply least-privilege RBAC on production buckets.
Control CTRL-IAM-03: Block public ACLs on storage buckets.
Requirement: Break-glass accounts must be monitored.

Section 3: Monitoring
Risk: Lack of audit logging delays incident response.
Control CTRL-MON-01: Enable access logging on all storage accounts.
Control CTRL-MON-02: Stream security findings to SIEM within 5 minutes.
Requirement: Retain logs for 365 days.

Section 4: Network
Risk: Unrestricted egress increases exfiltration risk.
Control CTRL-NET-01: Restrict egress to approved CIDRs.
